lead.headline: Maye’s 7:56 AM add made this a coin flip
lead.dek: Emmett Johnson in, Aaron Jones Sr. out, and the defending champ went from 43.4% to 48.7% against 7-2 Bad things man bad things. It kicks off first, at 6:30 AM in Munich.
lead.pull: Bad things man bad things 167.0. Maye I touch your TDs? 165.7. That’s 1.3 points, the closest game on the board.
body: At 7:56 AM Saturday, the front office I cover did the most useful thing a 2-7 team can do on a weekend: it found points. Emmett Johnson, the most-added player in all of fantasy, came in. Aaron Jones Sr. went out. Johnson projects for 16.44. Jones projected for 9.27. One free-agent click, seven points of projection, and Maye I touch your TDs? went from a 43.4% shot to 48.7% against Bad things man bad things.

Yesterday this desk called Johnson a flex body for AB81. Maye got there first, and AB81 still has six holes. The other worry broke the right way too: Amon-Ra St. Brown and A.J. Brown both came off the injury report since yesterday’s brief. St. Brown (19.42) starts. A.J. Brown (14.35) sits on the bench as the most expensive insurance policy in the league.

So here’s the board at last call: Bad things man bad things 167.0, Maye 165.7. Bad things is a 51.3% favorite by 1.3 points, and both lineups are already their best. Nobody has a lever left to pull. This one gets settled on the field.

Maye’s edge is under center. Brock Purdy (22.5) and Drake Maye (23.19) out-project Bad things’ C.J. Stroud (18.03) and Tyler Shough (17.43) by about 10 points. Bad things takes it back in the backfield: Bijan Robinson (20.42), Chuba Hubbard (18.84) and James Cook III (17.72) in the flex. Johnson and Bijan play in the same 10:00 AM window, so the new add gets graded head to head.

The clock is built for drama. Drake Maye and St. Brown go first, at 6:30 AM in Munich, before the rest of R.A.T.S. has finished its coffee. And Maye gets the last word: Zay Flowers (16.24) plays Monday at 5:15 PM. After Evan McPherson on Sunday night, Bad things has nobody left.

My pick is Maye, against the model. Better quarterbacks, the Monday finish, and a Saturday-morning move that looks like a team playing for something at 2-7. Elsewhere on the last-call board: Big Stric Energy is still favored from 36.36 down, Poochinski needs a quarterback and Aaron Rodgers plays until Sunday night, and AB81 has six lineup holes against a team that has already banked 75.2.

quick_hits.headline: Six holes, one Sunday, and a tiebreaker
quick_hits.body: AB81 is set at 78.39 and tops out at 93.66 against the Finest’s 183.58, a 0.9% shot. Joe Milton, Makai Lemon, Dallas Goedert, Darius Cooper and the Philadelphia Eagles D/ST are on bye, and Rhamondre Stevenson projects 0.0 in the flex. George Kittle (15.27) can slide in by Sun 1:25 PM; Aaron Rodgers (17.63), Brenton Strange (10.02) and the Indianapolis Colts D/ST (8.08) are on the wire for the rest. The week is gone, but AB81 has the fewest points of the three 7-2 teams, 1353.58, and every point on that tiebreaker counts.

quick_hits.headline: Rodgers would make Poochinski a real game
quick_hits.body: Caleb Williams is on bye with no quarterback behind him, so Poochinski sits at 136.66 as set and 146.37 with Quinshon Judkins in the flex. Aaron Rodgers (17.63) is still unrostered and doesn’t play until 5:20 PM Sunday. Add him and Poochinski projects within three points of Cherry Blossom’s 166.59, a lot closer than 31.3% sounds.

quick_hits.headline: Walker is Out. Wilson is the call, if he plays.
quick_hits.body: Kenneth Walker III went from Questionable to Out, so the Finest’s backfield slot takes a flex shuffle to get Garrett Wilson (14.31, Questionable, concussion) in by Sun 10:00 AM. Denzel Boston (10.63, toe) is still Questionable with no bench answer. The Finest are 99.1% to win; with the league’s fewest points, 1242.56, it’s the points that still matter.

quick_hits.headline: Still the favorite. Still down 36.36.
quick_hits.body: Big Stric Energy projects 149.48 to deeboliciouskins’ 145.6, a 54.1% edge with all 11 starters to play. deeboliciouskins’ only call is Tony Pollard (12.23) for the bye-week D’Andre Swift, and Pollard plays against Big Stric’s Jacksonville Jaguars D/ST. Big Stric’s last lever: Tucker Kraft (10.69) over Dalton Kincaid (9.79).

quick_hits.headline: Poochinski vs. Cherry Blossom starts in Munich
quick_hits.body: Poochinski’s Jahmyr Gibbs (24.57) and Sam LaPorta (12.0) share a field at 6:30 AM with Cherry Blossom’s Jared Goff (18.6), Jameson Williams (12.47) and Jake Bates (6.74). Maye’s Drake Maye and St. Brown are in the same game, and so is AB81’s Stevenson. Four R.A.T.S. teams have starters on the field before most of the league is awake.

quick_hits.headline: Bad things has nothing left to decide
quick_hits.body: Bad things man bad things projects 167.0, which is its best lineup. Ladd McConkey (Questionable, back) stays on the bench. A 7-2 team with a 42-21 all-play record doesn’t need to be clever this morning, and it isn’t trying.

w10-m1.headline: Big Stric, down 36.36, still the pick
w10-m1.blurb: Big Stric Energy 149.48, deeboliciouskins 145.6, 54.1% to 45.9%. deeboliciouskins banked 36.36 Thursday and has Pollard for Swift to make by Sun 10:00 AM. Big Stric has all 11 starters left, led by Josh Allen (24.1). Ja’Marr Chase (19.89) gives deeboliciouskins the Sunday-night last word.

w10-m2.headline: Matchup of the week, decided by 1.3
w10-m2.blurb: Bad things man bad things 167.0, Maye I touch your TDs? 165.7, 51.3% to 48.7%. Both lineups are their best. Maye’s quarterbacks against Bad things’ backfield, Emmett Johnson’s debut, and Zay Flowers on Monday night. The upset pick.

w10-m3.headline: The Finest, all but final
w10-m3.blurb: Santa Clara’s Finest have 75.2 banked and project 183.58; AB81 tops out at 93.66. A 99.1% favorite. The Finest’s calls are Wilson for Walker and Boston’s toe. AB81’s calls are everything else.

w10-m4.headline: Cherry Blossom, unless Poochinski finds a QB
w10-m4.blurb: Cherry Blossom 166.59, Poochinski 146.37 at its best without a second quarterback, 68.7% to 31.3%. Cherry Blossom is set. Poochinski needs Judkins for Burden and a QB for Williams, and Rodgers (17.63) would make it close. Then it’s on Poochinski’s Dallas stack at 1:25 PM.

w10-r6-s3.headline: deeboliciouskins at RB: Pollard, by 10:00 AM
w10-r6-s3.blurb: D’Andre Swift is on bye; Tony Pollard (12.23) is healthy and the only answer. The easiest call in the league, and it lines him up across from Big Stric’s defense.

w10-r7-s2.headline: Walker is Out. Wilson or the wire?
w10-r7-s2.blurb: Kenneth Walker III (groin) is Out. The bench answer is a flex shuffle for Garrett Wilson (14.31), Questionable with a concussion. Woody Marks (12.51) is the best back on the wire if Wilson trends the wrong way. Deadline Sun 10:00 AM. I’d play Wilson if he’s active.

w10-r7-s4.headline: Boston’s toe, still no backup
w10-r7-s4.blurb: Denzel Boston (10.63) is Questionable and the bench has no receiver who’s playing. Wan’Dale Robinson (11.35) is on the wire and projects higher either way.

w10-r8-s0.headline: AB81’s quarterback: the Rodgers race
w10-r8-s0.blurb: Joe Milton is on bye, Sam Darnold is Out and Jalen Hurts is on IR, so Matthew Stafford (16.27) is AB81’s only quarterback playing. Aaron Rodgers (17.63) is the best on the wire, and Poochinski needs him too. First come, first served; Drew Lock (16.21) is the consolation prize.

w10-r8-s5.headline: Kittle to the rescue, by 1:25 PM
w10-r8-s5.blurb: Makai Lemon is on bye. George Kittle (15.27) can come off the bench with a flex shuffle, the one AB81 hole the roster can fill on its own. Deadline Sun 1:25 PM.

w10-r8-s6.headline: AB81 at TE: Kittle can’t be in two places
w10-r8-s6.blurb: Dallas Goedert is on bye. Brenton Strange (10.02) and Hunter Henry (10.01) are the wire’s best tight ends. Henry plays at 6:30 AM in Munich, so Strange is the one with time on the clock.

w10-r8-s7.headline: Stevenson projects 0.0 in the flex
w10-r8-s7.blurb: Rhamondre Stevenson projects 0.0 in AB81’s flex and his game kicks off at 6:30 AM. Corey Kiner (11.78), from the same backfield, is unrostered.

w10-r2-s0.headline: Poochinski’s QB call can wait for Sunday night
w10-r2-s0.blurb: Dak Prescott (17.93) is Poochinski’s only quarterback playing. Rodgers (17.63) kicks off at 5:20 PM, so the call can wait until the last window, if AB81 doesn’t make it first. With Rodgers, Poochinski projects within three points of Cherry Blossom.

w10-r2-s8.headline: Burden’s flex: Judkins
w10-r2-s8.blurb: Luther Burden III is on bye. Quinshon Judkins (9.71) leads Jadarian Price (8.59) and Tyler Higbee (8.52). Judkins by Sun 10:00 AM.

trending_notes.13337: Emmett Johnson is the most-added player in fantasy, and Maye I touch your TDs? got him at 7:56 AM Saturday. He starts at RB for Maye, projecting 16.44.
trending_notes.12491: Corey Kiner (11.78) is on both trending lists and unrostered in R.A.T.S. AB81, with Stevenson at 0.0 in the flex, is the obvious home.
trending_notes.9480: Brenton Strange (10.02) is the best tight end on the wire. AB81 has Goedert on bye.
trending_notes.IND: The Indianapolis Colts D/ST (8.08) is trending up and unrostered. AB81’s Eagles are on bye.
trending_notes.3271: Tyler Higbee (8.52) is on both trending lists. On Poochinski he’s option three for the Burden flex.
trending_notes.5849: Kyler Murray is Out (hamstring) and among the most-dropped quarterbacks. deeboliciouskins has Mahomes and Daniels and doesn’t need him this week.
